admission.justification: Exact output alone is insufficient without the actual context, byte-preserving index comparison and truthful failure/refusal; together the six obligations prevent false restore acceptance from becoming destructive cancellation.

guarantee: For a required regular-path native reapply merge, restoration and cancellation use one carried-first result from the effective reapply worktree and carried-head attributes, preserve binary staged bytes in independent ownership checks, reject a distinct alternative result, and retain authority with a named non-mutating refusal when required acquisition or expected bytes cannot be proved. Separate raw-holder/fingerprint ownership remains narrower and grants no fallback restoration acceptance.
title: One reapply expectation for safe ownership and diagnosis
